policies.description: Repository governance authorities must agree with the canonical Constitution and registered semantic/verifier authorities.
policies.remediation: Align every repository governance authority with the Constitution before merge.

policies.description: Every changed path, including removed and renamed paths, must be classified.
policies.remediation: Register or classify the changed repository surface.

policies.description: Every changed executable must have a registered semantic executable class, not merely a path-level surface class.
policies.remediation: Register the executable class in the Constitution semantic executable registry.

policies.description: Add/delete/rename/copy classification must come from Git base/candidate trees.
policies.remediation: Use Git-native candidate identity and supported statuses.

policies.description: Deleted/renamed nodes must be classified and have zero unresolved reverse dependencies in the candidate tree.
policies.remediation: Update dependents to the replacement path or remove the reference, and preserve replacement evidence for renames/copies.

policies.description: Semantic graph nodes and dependency edges must be deterministically classified with no unresolved edge targets.
policies.remediation: Repair semantic registry classification or dependency references.

policies.description: Registered derived-state artifact dependencies must resolve and remain acyclic.
policies.remediation: Repair missing dependency references or dependency cycles.

policies.description: Workflow count may decrease toward the target but may never grow above the larger of the base count and target ceiling.
policies.remediation: Consolidate workflows; do not add another workflow authority.

policies.description: Every canonical governance control-plane file must be protected by the manual-review control surface.
policies.remediation: Register canonical control-plane paths in the convergence authority.

policies.description: Policy registry must be uniquely keyed and use safe declarative assertion primitives.
policies.remediation: Repair the policy registry contract and assertion declarations.
